faqs.question: What is the Yaksha research internship?
faqs.answer: Yaksha is a two-month, full-time research internship program at the Vicharanashala Lab, IIT Ropar. Interns work on real-world open-source repositories under a dedicated mentor.

faqs.question: How are the internship phases structured?
faqs.answer: The Yaksha internship is divided into phases (e.g., Phase 01). Each phase has specific criteria such as codebase audits, minor bug-fixes, or feature additions. Completing a phase requires a validated Pull Request merged by maintainers.

faqs.question: How do I run the full-stack portal locally?
faqs.answer: You can launch the entire stack using the root runner: `./run.sh`. This script handles local environment checks, setup, ngrok tunneling, and launches both frontend and backend watch servers.

faqs.question: Why does my local search fail with 'Embedding server connection error'?
faqs.answer: Local embedding generation falls back to an in-process ONNX pipeline using @xenova/transformers. If you don't have internet access to fetch the model initially, or if local loading fails, search will degrade to text-only matching.

faqs.question: Which package manager must be used in the monorepo?
faqs.answer: The project uses pnpm (configured in package.json packageManager). Do not use npm or yarn as they will conflict with pnpm-lock.yaml and Turborepo workspace configurations.

faqs.question: How do I toggle experimental feature flags like Golden Ticket?
faqs.answer: Admins can manage feature flags in the admin panel under `/admin/features`. Changes save to the FeatureFlag model and take effect instantly across frontend and backend without redeploying.

faqs.question: Why am I seeing 'Redis connection refused' warnings on boot?
faqs.answer: If Upstash Redis credentials (REDIS_URL / REDIS_TOKEN) are not set, the search cache and rate limiters fall back to standard in-memory caches. You can safely ignore this in development.
